conditions: Exception analysis determines that the body can throw checked class E.
The throws clause is absent or names only classes and lists neither E nor any superclass of E.
limitations: This covers the method and constructor body rule. Lambda bodies and initializers have their own checks.

triggers: Exact-edition correction, retrieval identity change, or material scope challenge.

statement: Java SE 21 rejects a method or constructor body at compile time if exception analysis says the body can throw a checked exception class and the declaration has no throws clause covering that class.
